newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling in bearish sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling in bearish sentiment.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall further in bearish sentiment ahead of Bengali News Year's day on Monday and a three-day Eid al-Adha Moslem festival beginning on Thursday, brokers said.
"There will be more sellers in the market as they need to cash shares for celebration of the festivals. The market may start picking up next week," said broker Khurshid Alam.
Brokers said share prices across the board could fall.
The DSE all-share price index closed 32.97 points or 2.89 percent down at 1,107.29 on turnover of 38 million taka on Saturday. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
